title: VendPoint Returns Desk Bulletin: Return Activity on the Machine
content:
For unused units of the item most recently added to a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine and returned during its start-up months, the machine's recent return activity sets a share of the credit.

**Rule.** The return-rate share follows the return lines on the machine in the three months ending today, counted by return date: at least the frequent-return count gives the frequent-return share, one or more but fewer give the some-returns share, and none gives a share of one.

**Figures.** The frequent-return count is 3 return lines; the frequent-return share is 0.95; the some-returns share is 0.98.

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

**What counts.** Every return line on the machine, for any item and any badge, dated within the three months ending today by its return date.

| Return lines on the machine, three months ending today | Return-rate share |
|---|---|
| None | 1 |
| 1 | 0.98 |
| 2 | 0.98 |
| 3 or more | 0.95 |

Hypothetical dates, today 20 May: a return line dated 21 February counts (two whole months back); one dated 20 February does not (three whole months back).
